name: MouseEpigeneticClock
input_level: methylation beta at 329 CpG sites; original paper processed FASTQ with Trim Galore+Bismark
project_relevance: direct baseline/comparator; useful for known clock sites and external sanity, not a raw ETL framework

name: scEpiAge
input_level: DNA methylation values in liver/lung/blood, sparse/single-cell aware
task: mouse age prediction in sparse/single-cell and low-coverage data
project_relevance: highly relevant for low coverage and missing-site robustness; possible model comparator after GSE225166/GSE225173 parser

name: MethylNet
species_scope: mostly human arrays but general DNAm matrices
input_level: methylation matrices, typically array beta values
project_relevance: architecture/reference for DL + interpretation; would require adapter from 5kb region beta matrix

name: MethFormer
task: masked methylation regression pretraining; downstream fine-tuning
project_relevance: closest open-source pattern for self-supervised methylation representation; may be useful once raw matrices scale

name: XAI-AGE
project_relevance: useful design pattern for pathway-aware interpretation; not directly mouse/RRBS ready

name: AltumAge
project_relevance: human-array benchmark only; not immediately usable for mouse raw RRBS

name: ComputAge Bench
input_level: harmonized methylation array beta matrices with metadata
task: benchmark biological age clocks on aging-accelerating conditions
project_relevance: benchmarking concept useful for biological-signal validation; data itself not mouse

name: YAME
input_level: sequence-level methylation counts/fractions and genomic coordinates
task: efficient methylome storage, summarization, enrichment, differential methylation
project_relevance: possible future storage/performance layer for large local raw ETL, not age model by itself
